gaps.sentence: He's got a ___ of stamps from every country he's visited.
gaps.explanation: Noun form: collection (a group of collected items).

gaps.sentence: The film is based ___ a true story.
The committee meets ___ other month, always on a Tuesday.
gaps.explanation: 'Every other month' = one month yes, one month no.

gaps.sentence: There was so ___ confusion that the event was abandoned.
I wish I ___ told him the truth at the time.
gaps.explanation: 'wish + past perfect' for regret about the past.

gaps.sentence: It was ___ dull a lecture that people walked out.
gaps.explanation: so + adjective (+a + noun) + that… — the alternative emphatic pattern.
